findings.description: check_tsan_supp.py and T-092 accept only race:^juce::<Class>::<function>$ lines; TSan matches templates against demangled frame names that end in a parameter list, so '$' after the function name never matches a function frame. Round 3 verified the anchors with race:^shared$, which matched a global-variable location, not a function frame. Template arguments and deadlock: lines are also refused.
findings.lens: technical correctness; CI platform coverage; past lessons
findings.conditions: T-304 under TSan produces any JUCE-internal report (ENVIRONMENT section 5 anticipates it)
findings.root_cause: verification of the anchored syntax exercised the global-location path instead of the function-frame path
findings.traces_to: tests/ci/check_tsan_supp.py, tests/py/test_tsan_supp_check.py (T-092), ci.yml host-tsan, ENVIRONMENT section 5, R-051, R-069, R-077, L-20261029T000000Z
findings.failure_path: S-320 host-tsan red on a JUCE-internal report -> tsan.supp gets an accepted anchored line -> T-092 passes, the job stays red -> S-320 Done when unreachable (implementer blocked); the likely deviation compiles JUCE sources without -fsanitize=thread, which passes R-077's nm check and hides wrapper-versus-JUCE races
findings.mitigation: TEST_CHALLENGE amendment: accept race:^juce::<Name>(<literal template args>)?(::<Name>)+( and deadlock: lines of that form (no $, no *); add a function-frame canary pair to host-tsan (suppressed pattern must exit 0, near miss must exit 66); forbid any deviation that removes -fsanitize=thread from a translation unit
findings.mitigation_adds: a positive and negative control on the code path that suppressions actually use

findings.description: A confirmation round answers only confirm or iterate; no rule applies the frozen pass condition (at most 8 of 12) to a confirmation round with pairs, and S-LISTEN's Done when both accepts 'confirm' and requires the last valid attempt's score to pass; seed and record name of a confirmation attempt are undefined.
findings.conditions: a confirmation round on a gate with pairs (G-L3 after a later reed change) scores 9 or more
findings.root_cause: the confirmation round was added without a pass condition or record rules
findings.traces_to: D-053 confirmation rule, GATES G-L allowed responses, S-LISTEN Done when, S-INTEGRATE action 3
findings.failure_path: harmonica iterate changes reed.cpp -> G-L3 confirmation, 10/12 -> owner answers confirm -> implementer reads the round-1 attempt as the last valid one -> Done when passes -> regressed accordion ships; or the implementer must guess
findings.mitigation: pass condition applies to confirmation rounds with pairs; confirm valid only at 8 or fewer, otherwise the proceed branch's question; seed = next attempt k of the last round; record listening/<gate>-round-<N>-confirm-<k>.md; Done when names it as the last valid attempt
findings.mitigation_adds: the frozen blind check covers the shipped code

findings.description: The confirmation trigger is a path list (core/, presets/, tools/folk-render/): it reopens gates for behaviour-neutral edits, is unbounded (an iterate given in a confirmation round lands in shared code and reopens the siblings, and nothing counts towards the round limit), and misses render-changing edits elsewhere (top-level compile flags).
findings.conditions: an iterate in a confirmation round of a reed or string gate, or any shared-frame fix
findings.root_cause: provenance checked by path, not by output
findings.failure_path: confirmation iterate in reed.cpp -> two sibling gates reopen -> repeat -> owner fatigue -> rubber-stamp confirm (feeds F-2)
findings.mitigation: reopen only when demos rebuilt at HEAD with the recorded seed differ from the gate's SHA256SUMS (rendering is deterministic, T-163); confirmation iterates count towards the round limit

findings.description: The 13th and 14th control references exist only for the accordion: S-REF stops searching at 12 notes per instrument, so every other instrument with pairs falls back to controls that repeat two real-pair clips byte for byte.
findings.conditions: any non-accordion instrument reaches 12 references (most likely the Philharmonia mandolin, G-L2)
findings.root_cause: S-REF stop rule not updated with D-053
findings.failure_path: S-REF indexes exactly 12 mandolin notes -> controls from mandolin-001/002 -> identical clips -> two free answers
findings.mitigation: stop the search at 14 where the source has more; keep 12 as D-051's threshold
findings.mitigation_adds: distinct control notes for every instrument with pairs

findings.description: R-077's check 'nm "$b" | grep -q __tsan_init' runs under bash -eo pipefail; grep exits at the first match and nm can die of SIGPIPE (status 141), failing the step with no defect.
findings.conditions: a long symbol tail after __tsan_init (likely with a statically linked TSan runtime)
findings.root_cause: grep -q in a pipeline under pipefail
findings.failure_path: S-320 host-tsan red intermittently; the implementer chases a non-existent race
findings.mitigation: write nm output to a file, then grep -q it

findings.description: D-053 applies the confirmation rule only to gates answered proceed or proceed-with-rescope; a gate closed with proceed-without-pairs is never reconfirmed.
findings.conditions: two void attempts, proceed-without-pairs, then a later shared change
findings.failure_path: proceed-without-pairs -> reed.cpp change -> no confirmation -> unheard audio ships

findings.description: On a repeat, S-REVIEW-DELTA reviews from the head it last reviewed, but its Done when requires DELTA_REVIEW.md to name the range from the S-ADVERSARIAL commit; an overwritten file names a partial range.
Each gate-evidence run force-pushes evidence/<gate id>, so the bundle a closed gate judged is replaced by later rounds and confirmation rounds; only PAIRS-SHA256SUMS is copied into records.
findings.conditions: any second round or confirmation round
findings.failure_path: records of earlier rounds point to other audio
findings.mitigation: copy SHA256SUMS into each gate record

findings.description: No frozen T-211 case covers the 2 GiB archive limit (R-075's mitigation).
findings.conditions: the limit is not implemented and a large archive is indexed
findings.mitigation: T-211 oversize case with a mocked stream

findings.description: Existing risks unchanged; among them R-028: the 1 GB TinySOL archive is downloaded on every push until reference is green, and on every pr-** run.

summary: Round 4: 9 findings plus one line of restatements. New: High 2 (F-1 inert anchored TSan suppressions; F-2 confirmation rounds without a pass condition), Medium 2 (F-3, F-5), Low 3 (F-7, F-8, F-9). Residual: Medium 2 (F-4 on R-071, F-6 on R-068). Effective: separate TinySOL cache keys and the metadata md5 check (R-067), unbalanced-key refusal (R-072), gen_presets tolerance (R-073), the S-REVIEW-DELTA repeat in S-INTEGRATE (R-070).
